title: Database connections
description: External databases that Data APIs, ETL pipelines, SQL jobs and database access management use. Passwords are encrypted and never shown again.

empty.title: No database connections yet
empty.description: Register a SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL or Oracle database so modules can use it.

forbidden.title: You can't view database connections
forbidden.description: Ask an administrator for the Database connection administrator role.

purposes.dataHint: Data APIs, ETL pipelines and SQL jobs.
purposes.adminHint: Creates accounts and grants roles (Database access). Never usable by Data APIs.

form.createDescription: Modules reach external databases only through connections registered here.
form.editDescription: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.
form.name: Name
form.keyHint: Modules refer to the connection by this key. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. It can't be changed later.
form.hostHint: A host name or IP address the API and worker can reach.
form.instanceHint: For a named SQL Server instance. The port is then discovered.
form.caStored: A CA certificate is stored. Paste a new one to replace it.
form.passwordStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
form.domainHint: For SQL Server Windows authentication with a service account (NTLM).
form.readOnlyHint: Writes are refused, and queries run in read-only transactions where the engine has them. SQL Server relies on the login's permissions.
form.leastPrivilege: Use a dedicated login with only the privileges it needs: read-only for Data APIs, role administration only for account management.

validation.name: Enter a name.
validation.key: Use 2–64 lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
validation.host: Enter a host name or IP address.

catalog.title: Catalog: {name}
catalog.description: Tables, views and routines that the connection's login can see.
catalog.empty: Nothing is visible to this login.
catalog.truncated: The catalog is large; only the first 20,000 entries are shown.
catalog.params: {count, plural, =0 {No parameters} one {# parameter} other {# parameters}}

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Modules that use this connection stop working with it: Data APIs, pipelines and jobs fail until they point at another connection. This can't be undone.
